# erp-change-placement
Read AGENTS.md and relevant rules. Identify business rule owner, available standard mechanism, supported extension and alternatives. Record cross-module impact and risk. Stop if vendor policy or owner unclear.
## Evidence
Record source, environment, exact revision, unknowns, validation results and proof level. Stop when any applicable gate is missing. Use deterministic tests rather than model confidence.
